About the collection

Built for Unpredictable Conditions

The First Wave Collection is where Oannes starts: a tight lineup of adaptable essentials designed for days that don't sit still. Each piece is engineered for movement, breathability, and sun on the water — from the cool-to-touch Crosscurrent Hooded Long Sleeve with thumbholes and a loop-and-button hood, to trail-ready Outbound Pants and the dock-to-dinner Current Polo.

Every garment is made or finished in the USA by American craftsmen, from dependable materials that hold up to sun, salt, soil, and sweat. This is apparel that moves with you — oceans, mountains, windy days, and everywhere life takes you.
